description: Photography agent for portrait posing, lighting/flash, composition, post-processing, commercial and wedding/children photography. Answers with concrete numbers, not adjectives; page-level citations when you supply your own book library.

description_i18n.en: Photography agent — portrait posing, lighting/flash, composition, post-processing, commercial and wedding/children photography. Ships original distilled notes and tooling only; no book text is included. Bring your own legally obtained library to get page-level citations.
